title: AlphaFlow
tagline: Autonomous multi-chain DeFi yield optimizer using Avail DA for cross-chain APY maximization.
description:
AlphaFlow is an autonomous multi-chain DeFi yield optimization platform that solves the problem of yield fragmentation across different blockchains. The platform aggregates real-time APY data from Aave V3 across multiple chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Avalanche) and automatically identifies the highest-yielding opportunities for users.

Key features include:

Multi-Chain Intelligence: Real-time APY comparison across 5+ supported chains
APY Optimization Engine: Automatic detection of better yield opportunities with calculated additional earnings
One-Click Cross-Chain Execution: Seamless bridging and supplying to optimal chains via Avail Nexus
Smart Contract Integration: Direct integration with Aave V3 pools using official address books
User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive UI showing current vs optimized yields with clear benefit calculations
The platform eliminates the need for users to manually check yields across different chains, handle complex bridging, and manage multiple transactions. Instead, users can optimize their DeFi yields with a single click, automatically moving funds to the chain offering the best APY while maintaining full custody of their assets.
how_its_made:
This project leverages cutting-edge Web3 technologies in a sophisticated multi-chain architecture:

Frontend Stack:

React 19 with TypeScript for type safety and modern UI patterns
Wagmi v2 + RainbowKit for comprehensive wallet integration
Custom React hooks for multi-chain state management
Lucide React for consistent iconography
Tailwind CSS for responsive design
Blockchain Integration:

@aave/react SDK for real-time APY data from official Aave V3 pools
@bgd-labs/aave-address-book for verified contract addresses across chains
Viem for low-level blockchain interactions
Custom multi-chain hooks that fetch data simultaneously from 5 chains
Cross-Chain Infrastructure:

Avail Nexus Widgets: The key innovation enabling seamless cross-chain operations
BridgeAndExecuteButton component for one-click bridge + supply operations
Custom optimization algorithms that calculate best APY chains in real-time
Smart contract parameter building for different chain configurations
Notable Technical Achievements:

Concurrent Multi-Chain Data Fetching: Custom useMultiChainAaveData hook fetches APY data from all supported chains simultaneously
Dynamic Chain Configuration: Automatic pool address and asset mapping based on target chains
Real-Time Optimization Detection: Algorithm continuously monitors for better yield opportunities
Seamless UX: Complex cross-chain operations abstracted into single-click actions
Partner Technology Benefits:

Avail DA Layer: Enables efficient cross-chain bridging with lower costs and better UX
Aave V3 SDK: Provides accurate, real-time market data and ensures compatibility
RainbowKit: Streamlines wallet connections across multiple chains
Hacky/Notable Implementation:

Built a custom getBestAPY function that dynamically compares yields across chains and calculates optimization benefits
Implemented error handling for chain icons with fallback mechanisms
Created a filtering system that hides chains with errors or unavailable data
Developed dynamic contract parameter building that adapts to different chain asset configurations
